body:
Player: vAlex1
Rule broken: Ban evading (Alexnonimo)
Evidence: So this player literally posted that his discord name is the one that his original account had (https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/172b16efc?reply=381391) 
Also we've just banned on Stratus Alexnonimo's account for evading vAlex1's ban actually thanks to the post mentioned above (after a previous IP check, obviously) (http://stratus.network/punishments/59b70f5b659e930001000160) (I guess it's not something really valid as it's other server but just to point it out)

Thank you.
